en: The image is a colored, vintage postcard depicting a panoramic view of a town surrounded by hills. The postcard prominently features a large, imposing institutional-looking building complex with expansive grounds and walls, likely a prison or facility, set against a backdrop of smaller town structures, red-roofed houses, and church towers. The image has a nostalgic, early 20th-century hand-tinted style. The words 'Waldheim.' and 'Königl. Strafanstalt.' are printed at the top.
